purpose: Locate unnecessary fast detours in the already validated C1 multi-cluster sparse pathspace; this is development, not a new confirmatory result.
cells: unchanged sparse gate and four leave-one-detour-out variants
diagnostics: GPU busy seconds per output token
selection_rule: A variant merits held-out testing only if mean all-completed and common-completed P95 TPOT are both lower than the unchanged gate, mean throughput drops by no more than 0.5%, and mean GPU busy seconds per output token rises by no more than 10%. Do not claim improvement from these two development seeds.
no_fitting: Only the four existing detour edges are individually removed. No route prices, bandwidth thresholds, workloads, placements, or margins are tuned after results.
